name: Ironclad Heart
description: Increases base health to 20. When played, you regain 5 health.

name: Vitality Infusion
description: Increases base health to 15. When played, you regain 10 health.

name: Quick Reflexes
description: Increases base number of cards played per turn to 5. When played, play 1 extra card.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Increases base number of cards played per turn to 4. When played, play 2 extra cards.

name: Bottomless Pockets
description: Increases base hand size to 7. When played, draw 1 card.

name: Tactical Reserve
description: Increases base hand size to 6. When played, draw 2 extra cards.

name: Brawny Strike
description: Increases base attack to 7. When played, deal 2 extra damage.

name: Sharpened Edge
description: Increases base attack to 6. When played, deal 4 extra damage.
